en.title: Withdrawing Tournament Revenue to Bank Accounts
en.excerpt: Step-by-step instructions for tournament organizers to withdraw collected participant registration fees from the organizer wallet balance.
en.content:
Tournament Revenue Balance

All registration fees paid via automated digital gateways accumulate in your Organizer Wallet in real-time. Net revenue reflects gross entry fees minus standard payment gateway transaction processing fees.

Submitting a Withdrawal Request

To request a payout:

  1. Open Organizer Dashboard > Balance / Wallet.
  2. Click Request Withdrawal.
  3. Select your registered bank account and input the amount you wish to disburse.
  4. Confirm the payout with your account password.

Settlement Timelines & History

Disbursements are processed within 1-2 business days. You can download official payout receipts and reconciliation statements for your tournament committee audit reports.
